in_sanskrit.name: Rahish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rahish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rahish means the one who rules or reigns over others. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja' which means king or ruler. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong and powerful leaders.
